title: For the patient who got the laboratory test of uric acid level as 8.4 on 19
question:
For the patient who got the laboratory test of uric acid level as 8.4 on 1991-10-21, how old was he/she at that time?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: how old at that time refers to SUBTRACT(year(test date), year(Birthday)); uric acid level as 8.4 refers to UA = '8.4'; 1991/10/21 refers to Date = '1991-10-21'

prediction.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUBSTR(L.XCL_015, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(SUBSTR(P.XCL_060, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.XCL_014 = P.XCL_058
WHERE L.XCL_022 = 8.4
  AND L.XCL_015 = '1991-10-21';
